index_line: - [[bowers-wilkins-705-s3]] — 8 Ω (EPDR min 1.9 Ω), 88.9 dB, ~+10 dB tweeter peak at 10 kHz (Stereophile, Tier B); $3,800
brand_notes: 705 S3 is the top 700-series standmount, tweeter-on-top carbon dome, $3,800 (launch $3,400). Stereophile measured a 10 kHz tweeter peak and low EPDR (1.9 Ω); critics generally praise clean, detailed sound but note coolness. B&W US lists all three S3 standmounts in stock; 606 S3 $1,200, 607 S3 $1,000 (min impedance 3.7 and 3.0 Ω per maker) - no Tier A/B measurements found for those.
takeaways: Only Tier B data: Stereophile MLSSA
Sensitivity 88.9 dB(B), min impedance ~3.9 Ω, EPDR min 1.9 Ω at 8.6 kHz: flagged effectively-4ohm
Tweeter rises ~10 dB to 10 kHz; shallow crossover ~3 kHz; vertical suckout
Critics: clean, detailed, cool; bass-light for large music
conflicts: Treble character: measured 10 dB peak vs What Hi-Fi? no bright edges
log_bullets: Impedance flagged effectively-4ohm (min below 4 Ω, EPDR 1.9 Ω)
